title: [Bookgolas Web Parity 19] Implement add-book form, schedule, status and priority lifecycle
final_revision: HEAD verified after the post-commit regression; see git history for the immutable commit

red.observed: Before implementation, npm reported Missing script: test:book-lifecycle.

details: Focused lifecycle suite passed 3 Vitest files and 14 tests.
Negative fixture modes passed for pages/date bounds, status transitions, foreign ownership and duplicate recovery.
Create and update contracts normalize dates, validate statuses and priorities, and revalidate localized consumer paths after save.
The happy path saved a selected book with planned status, priority and edited daily goal, then edited it to reading and refreshed home data.
The failure path blocked reversed dates in the client, exposed conflict retry recovery and returned a private 404 for a foreign update.
The form exposes localized metadata, lifecycle status, schedule preview/edit, priority controls and save state semantics.
Parity matrix passed 20 routes, 53 overlays and 8 capabilities; all 59 parity negative fixtures passed.
BLDS parity, BLDS negative, SSR state, UI primitive and UI primitive negative contracts passed.

guards.ownership: The verified session user id scopes both current-row reads and updates; caller ownership fields are rejected by strict schemas.
guards.transitions: The DAL enforces planned, reading, completed and will_retry transitions through canTransitionBookStatus.
guards.cache: Successful saves revalidate localized home, library, book detail and reading paths.
guards.recovery: Pending save disables duplicate submits; conflict, offline and typed auth errors retain retry or account actions.

blockers: The referenced .omo/plans/bookgolas-web-app-parity.md file is not present in this checkout; the required reference is retained in the contract and PR footer.
